title: Real Authentication and Mandatory ROE Gate
goal: Replace the X-Actor header with real API key authentication, and block run creation unless a Rules of Engagement reference is confirmed for the engagement.
scope: Two changes: (1) API KEY AUTHENTICATION: create api_keys table (id, key_hash VARCHAR 64, actor_name VARCHAR 255, role VARCHAR 50 default operator, created_at, last_used_at, revoked_at nullable). In api/app/auth/__init__.py replace get_current_actor with a function that first checks Authorization: Bearer {key} header, hashes it with SHA-256, looks it up in api_keys, updates last_used_at, returns actor_name. If no Bearer header, fall back to X-Actor for backwards compatibility (with deprecation warning in response headers). Add POST /api/v1/auth/keys endpoint to create keys (admin only in future, for now any actor). Add GET /api/v1/auth/keys to list keys. (2) ROE GATE: add authorization_confirmed_by (VARCHAR 255 nullable) and authorization_confirmed_at (DATETIME nullable) to Engagement model. In create_run (routers/runs.py), if engagement.roe_ref is null AND engagement.authorization_confirmed_at is null, return HTTP 400 with message: 'Written authorization is required before starting a scan. Set roe_ref or confirm authorization via PATCH /api/v1/engagements/{id}/confirm-authorization'. Add PATCH /api/v1/engagements/{id}/confirm-authorization endpoint that sets authorization_confirmed_by and authorization_confirmed_at. In wizard step 4 (renderGuidedLaunchStep), if engagement has no roe_ref, show a confirmation checkbox: 'I confirm I have written authorization from the system owner' that must be checked before Open Mission Control button is enabled.
generation_reason: X-Actor header is not authentication. Any client on the network can scan as any actor. No ROE enforcement means scans can start without legal authorization.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Auth and ROE gate only. No OAuth SSO. X-Actor fallback must remain for backwards compatibility.

success_criteria: Bearer token authentication works and returns correct actor_name.
create_run returns 400 if engagement has no roe_ref and no authorization_confirmed_at.
Wizard step 4 shows authorization checkbox when roe_ref is missing.

acceptance_criteria: API key auth works. ROE gate blocks unauthorized scans.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
